traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: A Nest rope
traversals.basis: Game metres. Rope under the ascender Kingdom_0_VertAscenderC (x,y -61.04, 8.79; housing z 8.97..9.48). a = the walk cell at its foot, b = the nearest cell of the floor it reaches. The floor reached is the Nest platform: 119 walk cells at z 5.70, an island of the walk grid (nothing walks onto it), 4.70 m above the ground floor. The Nest callout (-66.50, 9.00, z 16.75) is above this platform; no floor exists at the callout's height (3 cells at z 16.86).
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object position, the two walk cells, length 4.73 m); manual-approx (travel time = length / 6.75 m/s — speed assumed equal to the movement model's run speed (6.75 m/s): the game's rope / zipline speed was not measured; that the object is a usable rope: object name and game knowledge)

traversals.name: A site zipline (Nest <-> Rafters platform)
traversals.basis: Game metres. Two ascender housings at the same x and height: Kingdom_0_VertAscenderB.001 (-70.30, 10.38, z 7.72..8.00) over the Nest platform and Kingdom_0_VertAscenderB (-70.30, 34.05, z 7.73..8.04) over the platform on the far side of A site (127 walk cells at z 5.70, also an island). a, b = the platform cells under the two housings, 24.0 m apart.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object position, the two walk cells, length 24.00 m); manual-approx (travel time = length / 6.75 m/s — speed assumed equal to the movement model's run speed (6.75 m/s): the game's rope / zipline speed was not measured; that the object is a usable zipline: object name and game knowledge)

traversals.name: B Yellow rope
